query:
insert into ReviewAuthors (
                    latest_collection,
                    product_id,
                    review_name,
                    author
                )
                values (
                    $1,
                    $2,
                    $3,
                    $4
                )
                on conflict (
                    product_id,
                    review_name,
                    author
                ) do update
                set
                    latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection
